title: 第11章 深宫中的普通女子第12章 玫瑰园中的小可怜
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: 【碧落大丹】
品阶：地阶极品
介绍：使用后可以突破境界桎梏，大幅度提升修为境界
【驻颜丹】
介绍：奇珍异宝类物品，使用后可青春永驻，永久呈现最完美状态。
秦然看着两件宝贝，忍不住皱眉。
碧落大丹很有用处，至于驻颜丹，虽然十分罕见，但对他来说却完全就是鸡肋。
毕竟，高修为修炼者基本都可以做到维持青春面容，效果不会比驻颜丹差太多。
这奖励与昨日相比，差的不是一星半点……
“300％的任务完成度，奖励居然只有这种程度。”
“难道是因为…第一天是新手奖励？”
暂时也只有这个解释了。
不过任务难度终究只是c级，有地阶极品丹药作为奖励也很不错了……
秦然现在差的就是修为境界。
这碧落大丹是当前最适合之物。
秦然取出丹药，吞入腹中，同时运转云宫掠天术，屏蔽所有气息。
丹药入腹，迅速融化。
一缕缕清凉气息如灵蛇般钻入四肢百骸，疯狂强化着四肢及体内气血强度。
扑通！扑通！扑通！
秦然能清晰听到自己澎勃的心跳声。
修炼第一步的三个境界，主要是锤炼体魄。
碧落大丹中的恐怖药效完全激发，疯狂强化着肉身强度。
下一秒。
体内忽然传出一声清脆的嘎嘣声响，仿佛有一道无形的壁垒被药效霸道击穿……
一股前所未有的畅快感袭遍全身，整个人顿感脱胎换骨。
碧落大丹中的灵力还未耗尽。
修炼第一步的门槛，一跃而过，正式迈入修炼第二步。
法相境一重天。
法相境二重天。
法相境三重天。
药效渐渐消耗殆尽，最终的修为定格在了法相境三重天……
“这种感觉…”
秦然检查着自身状态，十分满意。
修炼第二步，共分为三个境界。
法相境、领域境、圣人境！
踏入法相境，已经达到了同龄普通天才的层次。
content_en:
【Bi Luo Da Dan】
Grade: top grade earth grade
Introduction: After use, you can break through the shackles of realm and greatly improve your cultivation realm.
【Zhu Yan Dan】
Introduction: Rare and rare items can stay young forever after use and appear in the most perfect state forever.
Kieran looked at the two treasures and couldn't help but frown.
The Biluo Great Pill was very useful. As for the Zhuyan Pill, although it was very rare, it was completely useless to him.
After all, high-level practitioners can basically maintain a youthful appearance, and the effect will not be much worse than that of the Beauty Pill.
Compared with yesterday, this reward is not even a little bit worse...
"300% mission completion, the reward is actually only this level."
"Is it because...the first day is a novice reward?"
This is the only explanation for the time being.
However, the difficulty of the mission is only C level after all, and having the best earth level elixir as a reward is also very good...
What Qin Ran is lacking now is his cultivation level.
This Biluo Dan is the most suitable thing at the moment.
Qin Ran took out the elixir, swallowed it into his belly, and at the same time used the Cloud Palace Sky Sweeping Technique to block all auras.
The elixir entered the abdomen and melted quickly.
Wisps of cool breath penetrated into the limbs and bones like spiritual snakes, crazily strengthening the strength of the limbs and the blood in the body.
thump! thump! thump!
Qin Ran could clearly hear his own pounding heartbeat.
The first three realms of cultivation are mainly about tempering the body.
The terrifying medicinal effect in Biluo Great Pill is fully activated, and the strength of the physical body is strengthened crazily.
The next second.
Suddenly there was a clear crunching sound in the body, as if an invisible barrier was penetrated by the overbearing effect of the medicine...
An unprecedented sense of pleasure swept through the whole body, and the whole person suddenly felt transformed.
The spiritual power in Biluo Great Pill has not been exhausted yet.
The threshold of the first step of cultivation has been crossed in one leap, and we have officially entered the second step of cultivation.
The Dharma Realm is on the first level.
The second level of Dharma Realm.
The third level of Dharma Realm.
The effect of the medicine is gradually exhausted, and the final cultivation level is fixed at the third level of Dharma Realm...
"This feeling..."
Qin Ran checked his condition and was very satisfied.
The second step of cultivation is divided into three realms.
Dharma phase realm, realm realm, saint realm!
Stepping into the Dharma Realm, he has reached the level of an ordinary genius of the same age.
